Vs . 
 The Union of India through the Secretary

.. Respondents
 Dr. Ramdas P. Sabban for the Petitioner.
 Ms.M. S. Bane, Agp for the State-Respondent.
 Coram:- R. D. Dhanuka &
 M. M. Sathaye, Jj.
 Date :- January 17, 2023.

The short grievance of the Petitioner Association is that the Respondent authorities have not displayed the land acquisition proceeding along with the compensation amounts awarded and paid to the Claimants on the website created for this purpose as required under Section 37 (3) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

sentences.text: 2 Dr. Sabban, learned counsel appearing for the Petit  Aswale   24.wp.454.2023.doc seeks liberty to delete the name of Respondent No.1 from the cause title of the Petition as no reliefs are sought against Respondent No.1.
Leave to amend the cause title of the Petition is granted.
Amendment to be carried out forthwith.
Amendment to be also carried out in the copy supplied to Respondent No.2 who now to be numbered as the Sole Respondent.
3 Ms. Bane, learned A. G. P. for the State waives service for the Respondent.

Affidavit in reply,
if any, to be filed within three weeks from today with a copy to be served upon the Petitioner's advocate simultaneously.
Rejoinder, if any, to be filed within a period of three weeks thereafter with a copy to be served upon the Respondents' advocate simultaneously.

( M. M. SATHAYE, J. ) ( R. D. DHANUKA, J. )
